and thermal performance.
Enhanced 12+4PIN terminal structure:

design reduce impedance, improve
insertion/extraction force performance, and achieve
lower temperature.
5-year warranty: This unit comes with a standard
limited manufacturing warranty of 5 years from
the date of purchase.
